name: United Stables U
who_can_redeem: Approved Mint Users that complete KYB, wallet approval, and program onboarding may mint and redeem directly with the issuer.
redemption_region_notes: Jurisdiction, identity, wallet-screening, compliance, banking, and settlement restrictions apply.
redemption_notes: Secondary-market holders do not automatically receive direct issuer redemption rights. Base U remains separate from exchange rewards, wrappers, and staking positions.
summary: United Stables dollar token backed under an issuer-managed reserve model using cash, Treasury bills, and selected fiat-referenced stablecoins, with direct issuance and redemption restricted to approved users.
notes: Batch O. Launch is fixed to the dated Ethereum and BNB Chain announcement. Exact contracts, reserve allocation, custodians, and recurring attestation history remain explicit known unknowns.

name: USDGO
who_can_redeem: Eligible institutional and enterprise participants may use supported USDGO issuance and redemption channels under Anchorage and distribution-partner terms.
redemption_region_notes: Institutional onboarding, jurisdiction, banking, compliance, distribution, and settlement restrictions apply.
redemption_notes: OSL branding and distribution are separate from Anchorage Digital Bank issuance. Exchange campaigns and reserve income do not create intrinsic holder yield.
summary: Enterprise-focused USD stablecoin issued by Anchorage Digital Bank and launched through OSL on Solana with reserves described as cash and high-quality liquid assets.
notes: Batch O. Issuer, branding operator, distributor, reserve manager, and audit roles remain separately attributable.

name: SoFiUSD
who_can_redeem: Eligible SoFi, enterprise, and supported-wallet users may convert SoFiUSD at one U.S. dollar under applicable product and account terms.
redemption_region_notes: Account eligibility, jurisdiction, identity, sanctions, wallet, banking, and blockchain-network restrictions apply.
redemption_notes: SoFiUSD is a payment stablecoin and is not the same product as future interest-bearing tokenized bank deposits.
summary: Payment stablecoin issued by SoFi Bank, N.A., branded SoFiUSD and represented on-chain by the SOFID symbol, with full-reserve and one-to-one redemption claims.
notes: Batch O. Infrastructure launch and later consumer-platform availability are recorded as separate events.

name: Solstice USX
who_can_redeem: Users of supported Solstice protocol routes may enter or exit base USX subject to collateral, strategy, liquidity, and interface conditions.
redemption_region_notes: Network, interface, strategy, jurisdiction, liquidity, and partner restrictions may apply.
redemption_notes: Base Solstice USX is separate from dForce USX, eUSX, YieldVault positions, reward balances, and partner-protocol receipts.
summary: Solana-native Solstice stablecoin connected to protocol-managed reserves and institutional yield strategies, with yield-bearing representations kept separate from the base token.
notes: Batch O. The canonical Solana mint, reserve custody, strategy allocation, and December 2025 peg-intervention chronology remain under review.

name: Origin Dollar
who_can_redeem: Users may redeem OUSD through supported Origin protocol routes into USDC under current liquidity, strategy, fee, and contract conditions.
redemption_region_notes: Interface, jurisdiction, strategy, liquidity, gas, and contract conditions apply.
redemption_notes: OUSD distributes strategy income through rebasing. Wrapped OUSD converts the same economic exposure into a non-rebasing representation and remains a separate asset relationship.
summary: Ethereum rebasing stablecoin that deploys stablecoin reserves into on-chain strategies and distributes resulting yield directly through balance rebasing.
notes: Batch O. The November 2020 exploit and compensation process are recorded separately from the original launch and current active status.
